articles.excerpt: Adarsh Baal Vidyalaya stars Menon as a gloriously lazy headmaster forced to save the worst school in town. Archana Puran Singh and Naveen Kasturia round out the cast. It premieres July 24 on Prime Video.

articles.title: Lokesh Kanagaraj Is Making a Superhero Film With Aamir Khan. It's Aimed at the World.

articles.title: Alia Bhatt's Best Friend Married the Man Who Made Gunjan Saxena. Bollywood Showed Up.
articles.excerpt: Akanksha Ranjan Kapoor and filmmaker Sharan Sharma tied the knot on the anniversary of their first date. The sangeet went viral. The reception was packed with stars.

articles.title: Samantha's ₹100 Crore Blockbuster Hits JioHotstar This Thursday. She Shot Part of It With Morning Sickness.
articles.excerpt: Maa Inti Bangaaram is the highest-grossing solo female-led Telugu film ever. Now the pregnant star — who also produced it with husband Raj Nidimoru — is taking a maternity break on the biggest high of her career.
articles.image_caption: Samantha Ruth Prabhu in Maa Inti Bangaaram, the highest-grossing solo female-led Telugu film ever (Wikipedia)

articles.title: Dhamaal 4 Just Crossed ₹65 Crore in Three Days. The Franchise Has Never Done This.
articles.excerpt: A ₹14 crore Friday, a ₹22 crore Saturday, and a ₹28 crore Sunday later, the fourth instalment of Bollywood's most chaotic franchise has smashed every record the series ever set — and it's about to hit ₹100 crore worldwide.
articles.image_caption: Official poster for Dhamaal 4 (2026)

articles.title: Sunny Deol Just Made His OTT Debut. Twenty-Nine Years After Border, He's Back With Akshaye Khanna.
articles.excerpt: Ikka reunites two of Bollywood's most electrifying screen presences in a courtroom thriller on Netflix — and while the film divides critics, Sunny's emotional tribute to his late father Dharmendra might be the real story.

articles.title: Ranbir Kapoor and Yash Are Taking Ramayana to Comic-Con. No Indian Film Has Ever Done This.
articles.excerpt: The most expensive Indian film ever made gets a full panel at San Diego Comic-Con on July 23, with the worldwide trailer dropping July 24. Hans Zimmer and AR Rahman are scoring it. This is not normal.
